abstract.p: Provided herein is a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) comprising a polypeptide comprising: (a) an extracellular antigen binding domain comprising a first anti-B cell maturation antigen (BCMA) single domain antibody (sdAb) comprising the complementarity determining regions (CDRs) of the amino acid sequence of SEQ ID NO: 125 and a second anti-BCMA sdAb; (b) a transmembrane domain; and (c) an intracellular signaling domain. Further provided herein are: an isolated nucleic acid comprising a nucleic acid sequence encoding said CAR; a vector comprising said isolated nucleic acid; an engineered immune effector cell comprising said CAR, said isolated nucleic acid or said vector; and a pharmaceutical composition comprising said engineered immune effector cell and a pharmaceutically acceptable carrier. Also provided herein is a CAR or a pharmaceutical composition of the invention for use in a method of treating cancer in an individual.
